card.fact_statement: The National Electoral Council is an organization involved in the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election protests.
card.source_span: the government-controlled National Electoral Council (CNE) announced an unsubstantiated result

target_qa_variants.question: ما هي المنظمة الخاضعة لسيطرة الحكومة التي تورطت في احتجاجات الانتخابات الرئاسية الفنزويلية لعام 2024 من خلال إعلان نتيجة غير مدعومة بأدلة؟
target_qa_variants.source_span: the government-controlled National Electoral Council (CNE) announced an unsubstantiated result
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'National Electoral Council' to its standard Arabic equivalent 'المجلس الانتخابي الوطني'.

backtranslation_en.question: What is the government-controlled organization that was involved in the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election protests by announcing a result unsupported by evidence?
